headline: BNZ raises mortgage rates, undercuts major bank hikes
caption: BNZ has joined the recent rate hike trend, but here's the good news for East Auckland borrowers — their new rates are actually lower than what ANZ, Westpac, and Kiwibank are charging. If you're on a fixed mortgage or considering refinancing, it's worth comparing what BNZ is offering right now. Every basis point counts when it comes to your home loan!
original_title: BNZ raises mortgage and term deposit rates
